title: Le livre de tous les ménages, fourth edition: 1810 ministerial letter
version: Fourth edition, pp. 239–240, letter of 30 January 1810
lineage: Project Gutenberg transcription of a later edition reprinting the 1810 ministerial letter.

passages.note: The fourth edition reproduces a minister’s letter dated 30 January 1810 granting 12,000 francs, conditional on printing and delivering 200 copies of a description. It is a reprint of the letter, not the original manuscript.
